reasons.plausibility: The proposed mechanism of kinetic trapping versus thermodynamic segregation in rapidly heated and cooled noble-metal HEA nanoparticles aligns well with established principles of diffusion-limited phase formation, albeit with some minor uncertainties (e.g., exact dwell-time thresholds).
reasons.testability: The side-by-side synthesis with short vs. extended dwell times and subsequent XRD/STEM-EDS characterization is a clear and decisive approach to confirm or refute the predicted phase changes.
reasons.usefulness: These insights directly inform how to tune processing parameters to control phase stability in noble-metal HEA nanoparticles and are therefore highly relevant and helpful to researchers in this field.
